Rule.Name: Ensure Options is set to None for OS root directory (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Options for the OS root directory are not restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set the Options directive to "None" for the root directory.
Rule.Correction: echo "<Directory />" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo " Options None" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "</Directory>" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure Options is set appropriately for DocumentRoot (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Web root directory options are not restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set the Options directive to "None" for the DocumentRoot in all active VirtualHost configurations.
Rule.Correction: for file in /etc/apache2/sites-available/*.conf; do sed -i '/<Directory \/var\/www\/html>/,/<\/Directory>/ s/^\s*Options .*/ Options None/' "$file"; done; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure Options is minimized for non-critical directories (Manual)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Options for non-critical directories are not minimized.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Review and reduce the Options directives for directories that do not require extended functionality.
Rule.Correction: Manual review required; update Options directives in apache2.conf or site configs to minimal values.

Rule.Name: Ensure default index.html content is removed (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Remove default index.html content from the DocumentRoot.

Rule.Name: Ensure default CGI printenv script is removed (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Default CGI printenv script is present.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Remove the default printenv script from the CGI directory.

Rule.Name: Ensure default CGI test-cgi script is removed (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Default CGI test-cgi script is present.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Remove the default test-cgi script from the CGI directory.

Rule.Name: Ensure HTTP methods are restricted via LimitExcept (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: HTTP request methods are not restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a LimitExcept directive inside each VirtualHost to allow only GET, HEAD, POST, and OPTIONS.
Rule.Correction:
for site in /etc/apache2/sites-available/*.conf; do if ! grep -q "<LimitExcept GET HEAD POST OPTIONS>" "$site"; then sed -i '/</VirtualHost>/i \ \ \ \ <Directory /var/www/html>
\ \ \ \ \ \ <LimitExcept GET HEAD POST OPTIONS>
\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ Require all denied
\ \ \ \ \ \ </LimitExcept>
\ \ \ \ </Directory>' "$site"; fi; done; service apache2 reload
Rule.Verification: grep -Rq "<LimitExcept GET HEAD POST OPTIONS>" /etc/apache2/sites-available/*.conf && echo 0 || echo 1

Rule.Name: Ensure HTTP TRACE method is disabled (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Disable the HTTP TRACE method by setting TraceEnable to Off.

Rule.Name: Ensure only HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 protocols are allowed (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Old HTTP protocol versions are allowed.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Implement rewrite rules to block requests not using HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2.
Rule.Correction: echo "RewriteEngine On" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} !HTTP/1\\.1$" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "RewriteRule .* - [F]" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure access to .ht* files is restricted (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Access to .ht* files is not restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a FilesMatch directive to deny access to files beginning with .ht.
Rule.Correction: echo "<FilesMatch \"^\\.ht\">" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo " Require all denied" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "</FilesMatch>" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure access to .git directories is restricted (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Access to .git files is not restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a DirectoryMatch directive to deny access to .git directories.
Rule.Correction: echo "<DirectoryMatch \"/\\.git\">" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo " Require all denied" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "</DirectoryMatch>" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure access to .svn directories is restricted (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Access to .svn files is not restricted.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a DirectoryMatch directive to deny access to .svn directories.
Rule.Correction: echo "<DirectoryMatch \"/\\.svn\">" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo " Require all denied" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "</DirectoryMatch>" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure only allowed file extensions are accessible (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Inappropriate file extensions may be accessible.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Create a FilesMatch directive that allows only approved file extensions.
Rule.Correction: echo '<FilesMatch "^.*\.(css|html?|js|pdf|txt|xml|xsl|gif|ico|jpe?g|png)$">' > /etc/apache2/conf-available/allowed_extensions.conf; echo ' Require all granted' >> /etc/apache2/conf-available/allowed_extensions.conf; echo '</FilesMatch>' >> /etc/apache2/conf-available/allowed_extensions.conf; a2enconf allowed_extensions; service apache2 reload
Rule.Verification: test -f /etc/apache2/conf-available/allowed_extensions.conf && grep -q "Require all granted" /etc/apache2/conf-available/allowed_extensions.conf && echo 0 || echo 1

Rule.Name: Ensure IP address-based requests are blocked (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: IP address based requests are allowed.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add rewrite rules to block requests with a numeric Host header.
Rule.Correction: echo "RewriteEngine On" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^[0-9\\.]+$ [NC]" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; echo "RewriteRule .* - [F]" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure Listen directives specify IP addresses (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Listen directives do not specify an IP address.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Update the Listen directives to include the specific IP address.

Rule.Name: Ensure Content-Security-Policy header restricts framing (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: No header is configured to restrict browser framing.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a Header directive to restrict framing via Content-Security-Policy.
Rule.Correction: echo "Header always append Content-Security-Policy \"frame-ancestors 'self'\"" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload
Rule.Verification: grep -q "Header always append Content-Security-Policy" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf && echo 0 || echo 1

Rule.Name: Ensure Referrer-Policy header is set appropriately (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a Header directive to set the Referrer-Policy header appropriately.
Rule.Correction: echo "Header set Referrer-Policy \"no-referrer-when-downgrade\"" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload

Rule.Name: Ensure Permissions-Policy header is set appropriately (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Add a Header directive to set the Permissions-Policy header with an appropriate allowlist.
Rule.Correction: echo "Header set Permissions-Policy \"geolocation=(), microphone=()\"" >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; service apache2 reload
